segments.he: וזה בחינת ד' מחנות הדגלים שהלכו ישראל בכל מסעיהם בד' מחנות הדגלים שהם שנים עשר שבטי יה שהם בחינת קשור המרכבה שהיא כלולה מד' מחנות כידוע, שהם בחינת הד' מלאכים שסימנם ארגמן שהם בחינת קשור המרכבה, כמו שכתוב שם בהתורה הנ"ל שעל-ידי-זה תקון המשפט, כמו שכתוב שם, וזהו שבטי יה עדות לישראל וכו' כי שמה ישבו כסאות למשפט כסאות לבית דוד וכו', כי כסאות למשפט נתתקנין על-ידי שבטי יה שהם ד' מחנות שהם בחינת קשור המרכבה וכו', כי כל זמן שלא נתתקנין כל התקונים הנ"ל בשלמות עד שזוכין לתקון המשפט בחינת קשור המרכבה, אזי גם האמונה עדין לא נתתקנה בשלמות, כי כל זמן שיש עדין איזה פגם הברית חס ושלום, עדין אין האמונה בשלמות. כי הא בהא תליא כמבאר במקום אחר (סימן לא), ועל-כן עקר התקון כשממשיכין האור מיחוד הפנימי מבחינת עתיק שעל-ידי-זה משיגין שער הנ' שעל-ידי -זה זוכין לתקון המשפט, ואז נתתקן הכל בשלמות כמו שיהיה בימי משיח שיבא במהרה בימינו אמן:
segments.en: Because corruption is corruption and it is hard. Rashi said: "And not all the days of Joshua did they not corrupt him, etc." But from here, that every time that you learn it exists, as if it had not died, etc." And it is hard: Is not the truly tzaddik called to live forever, as our rabbis said, on the verse "Beniah the son of Jehoiada the son of a living man, etc." From all that dwells And all that Moses our master in the Vedas lives and exists forever, and as it is explained in the Midrash of Ravah, that Moses our master did not die, for he stands and serves on high. And as it is written in the Zohar of the Holy One (Parashat Teroma, Daff Kad): "And Moses did not die, and what is written: "And the day Moses died" is from the smiting of There: I found a place for Tzedekiah called Beh Mitha, he is a scribe of Dilan, an eye there. But in truth, everything is fine, because this is the meaning of the midrash that the Rashi brought, they are the Rashi in the name of the midrash who interprets the meaning of the verse that is not like the simple one that after his death the simple one will destroy it, because we do not see that they did not destroy it. After the death of the simple one, as it is written: "And they served Hashem all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, etc." But the wise man is more confused than this, because the meaning of the ark of death is what the tzaddik Rabbi, the true Rabbi, said to his disciples, "It is the trial of Moses, not the simple death." May mercy and peace be upon the children of Adam, for in the knowledge of the tzaddik, the tzaddik live and stand forever, as our rabbis said, "In the number of places where there is no number, the tzaddik are called alive in their death." The Ark of the Covenant is empty, as it is written in the holy book of the Zohar, which is translated, "Moses did not die, only what is written in his shadow, and Moses died, is Mistra Dilan and others. And yet, truly, all the time that you will learn that a man exists as if he did not die, even though we truly see that he is buried, dead, and buried, yet truly, truly, he does not die at all, only from our side, that we do not see him, but from the heat that you will learn that he exists and speaks his Torah, from his name and from teaching. For others, in the future, there will be no death on our part, because the essence of life is the wisdom of the Holy Torah, as it is written: "Your life is because of you." As it is written: "Wisdom is life," the Holy Torah is wisdom, it is the only true wisdom that gives life to all souls, as it is written: "The Torah of the 'Tamimah answers "Therefore, as long as the disciple of the tzaddik one lives and reveals his Torah, the Holy One of God certainly does not die. Therefore, what is written about the death of Moses is only a punishment, just as it is written in the aforementioned Zohar. And if so, according to our ways, now the verse will be interpreted thus: For I know that after my death, that corruption will be corrupted, Whenever it is called after my death, remember that you will not deal with my Torah as if you were seeing me, and you will seek and seek but you will not find it) as the prophet Isaiah warned them about this: "And Moses remembered the days of the world with his people, saying, 'Where is the secret from the day?'" (Then it will be called 'after my death,' which is in the garden of death, which is from the punishment of his friends. And then corruption is corruption, etc. But all the days of Joshua and the elders who dealt well with the law of Moses and who curled and sought Moses, in whom the Holy Spirit was holy, did not certainly corrupt him, because they served him all their days. And then certainly it was considered that Moses was alive, because Moses truly did not die, etc. And so it is from generation to generation. For ever, in all times when tzaddik people are found who practice as seen in the Torah of Moses, it is considered that they are not like the children of Didan, but also Moses. And when they are addressed with peace and mercy, then peace and mercy are called for Didan, 'after his death.') Hilkot Shlochin–Halakaha, 12 (To our brothers, the whole house of Israel, a publication of the Pentateuch with the commentary of the Law of Laws, at the price of the foundation, § 125, for the set)

segments.he: ועל-כן ישראל נקראים פעמים בשם עבדים להשם יתברך ופעמים בשם בנים, כמו שכתוב ( ויקרא כ"ה), "כי לי בני ישראל עבדים עבדי הם אשר הוצאתי אותם מארץ מצרים ( שם) לא ימכרו ממכרת עבד" כי בחינת עבד ממש אין אחיזה בהם, בחינת לא ימכרו ממכרת עבד, כי הם עבדים דקדשה עבדי ה' אשר הוציאם מארץ מצרים מבית עבדים מבחינת עבדות שזה היה עקר הגלות על-ידי התגברות עבדות דסטרא אחרא וכו' כנ"ל ופעמים נקראים בשם בנים, כמו שכתוב ( שמות ד'), "בני בכורי ישראל" וכמו שכתוב ( דברים י"ד), "בנים אתם לה' אלקיכם לא תתגודדו וכו'" כי צריכין שני בחינות הנ"ל בתחלה בהכרח שתהיה העבודה בבחינת עבדות וכנ"ל ואחר כך זוכין לבחינת בן כנ"ל:
segments.en: And therefore Israel is sometimes called by the name of servants, in whose name he shall be blessed, and sometimes by the name of sons, as it is written (and he called them), "For the children of Israel are servants to me; they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt (there); they shall not be sold as slaves" because when a slave is bought, there is no hold on them, when they are bought, they shall not be sold as slaves, because they are servants. The holiness of the servants of Hashem, who were brought out of the land of Egypt from the house of slaves, was a sign of servitude, which was the principle of the exile at the hands of the men of the later Deuteronomy, and so on, and sometimes they were called by the name of sons, as it is written (Shemot D'), "My sons, my firstborn Israel," and as it is written (Deuteronomy 14), "You are sons of Hashem." "Your God, you shall not be arrogant, and so on." Because the two above-mentioned tests were repeated, initially with the necessity that the work be in the test of servitude and servitude, and later on, thus, the test of the son of servitude was passed:

segments.he: כי באמת גם עיקר תיקון התשובה הוא על יד התערותא דלתתא אף על פי שאי אפשר לו לתקן החטא כי אם על ידי בחינ ההנהגה של מעלה מעלה כנ"ל אף על פי כן אינו זוכה לזה כי אם על ידי תשובה תבפלה ותחנונים וכו' שהם בחינת אתעררותא דלתתא אדרבא הבעל דבר צריך להתגבר בעובדות בתורה ותפלה ומעשים טובים יותר ויותר כי צריך אתעוררותא דלתתא יותר ויותר שזהו בחינת מה שהבעל דבר צריך להוסיף קדושה על עצמו כגון תענית או להרבות בתלמוד תורה וצדקה ומעשים טובים וכו'כמובא בספרים אם היה רגיל ללמוד דף אחד ילמוד שני דפין וכו'. כי מאחר שפגם בעוונותיו ופלם בבחינת אתעורותא דלתתא על כן שפלם בעוונותיו ופגם בבחנית אתעוררותא דלתתא על כן צריך עת הלהתגבר בהתעררותא דלתתא יותר ויותר כדי שיזכה להמשיך עליו אתעוררותא דלעילא ממקום גבוה ועליון יותר ששם מתתקן הכל ששם תהפכין העוונות לזכיות כנ"ל. כי כל מה שהאתעוררותא דלתתא בהתגברות בהתגברות גדול ובקדושה גדולה ביותר כמו כן זוכה להמשיך אתעוררותא דלעילא ממקום גבוה ועליון יותר. ועל כן צריך הבעל דבר לקדש עצמו בבחינת אתעררותא דלתתא ביותר כדי שימשיך עליו אתעוררותא דלעילא ממקום גבוה יותר ששם מתתקן הכל כנ"ל:
segments.en: And therefore Israel is sometimes called by the name of servants, in whose name he shall be blessed, and sometimes by the name of sons, as it is written (and he called them), "For the children of Israel are servants to me; they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt (there); they shall not be sold as slaves" because when a slave is bought, there is no hold on them, when they are bought, they shall not be sold as slaves, because they are servants. The holiness of the servants of Hashem, who were brought out of the land of Egypt from the house of slaves, was a sign of servitude, which was the principle of the exile at the hands of the men of the later Deuteronomy, and so on, and sometimes they were called by the name of sons, as it is written (Shemot D'), "My sons, my firstborn Israel," and as it is written (Deuteronomy 14), "You are sons of Hashem." "Your God, you shall not be arrogant, and so on." Because the two above-mentioned tests were repeated, initially with the necessity that the work be in the test of servitude and servitude, and later on, thus, the test of the son of servitude was passed:

segments.he: אות מג
segments.en: Because truly, the main point of correcting the teshuvah is by the Ḥaterutah Deltata, even though it is not possible for him to correct the sin, except through the grace of the guidance of Ma'aleh Ma'aleh, as mentioned above. Nevertheless, he does not merit this, except through teshuvah, prayer, and supplications, etc., which are aspects of Ḥaterutah Deltata. On the contrary, the person who has committed the deed must overcome in the deeds of Torah, prayer, and good deeds more and more, because he needs Ḥiterutah Deltata more and more, which is the aspect of what the person who has committed the deed must add holiness to himself, such as fasting or increasing in Torah study and charity and good deeds, etc., as stated in the books. If he was accustomed to studying one page, he would study two pages, etc. Because since he has sinned in his sins and fallen in the aspect of Ḥaterutah Deltata, therefore he has sinned in his sins and fallen in the examination of Ḥiterutah Deltata, therefore he needs time to overcome in the Ḥiterutah Deltata more and more, so that he may merit continuing on him Ḥiterutah Deltata from a higher and more elevated place, where everything is corrected, where everything is transformed. The sins are the same as the above. Because everything that is awakened with a greater and greater increase in holiness also deserves to continue to awaken from above from a higher and more exalted place. Therefore, the owner of a thing must sanctify himself in the form of an extremely low awakening so that he may continue to awaken from above from a higher place where everything is corrected as above:

segments.he: ובזה טעה שמשון, כי ראה שישראל כבושים מאד תחת הפלשתים, וראה שקשה לברר הטוב מהם להציל את ישראל, וסבר שעל-ידי בחינת הולדה יברר הטוב מהם, כי ידע שיש טוב שאי אפשר לברר מהקלפות כי אם על-ידי הולדה כנ"ל בהתורה הנ"ל. ועל-כן הלך לשא אשה משם. ובאמת ראה ולא ידע מה ראה, כי באמת מה' היה מה שהלך לקח אשה משם. ואף-על-פי-כן הוא בבחירתו לא היה צריך לילך אחר זה, כי זה הדבר אי אפשר להשיג כנ"ל. וזה בחינת בדרך שאדם רוצה לילך מוליכין אותו, כמו שכתוב, "קום לך אתם ואפס את הדבר וכו'". שאף-על-פי שה' יתברך גמר כרצונו וישראל קבלו ברכות הרבה על-ידי בלעם, אף-על-פי-כן הוא לא היה צריך להתרצות בהליכה זו. וכשהלך אף-על-פי שה' גמר כרצונו, אף-על-פי-כן נענש הרבה לעולם, כמו שאמרו רבותינו זכרונם לברכה, שם:
segments.en: And Samson was mistaken, because he saw that Israel was greatly humiliated under the Philistines, and he saw that it was difficult to choose the best among them to save Israel, and he thought that by the grace of the mother he would choose the best among them, because he knew that there is a good that cannot be chosen from the skins, because if by the grace of the mother, as mentioned in the above Torah. And so he went to take a wife from there. And indeed he saw, but he did not know what he saw, for indeed it was from Hashem that he went to take a wife from there. And yet, in His choice, there was no need for a night later than this, for this is the thing that cannot be achieved as usual. And this is a test in the way that a person wants to spend a night leading him, as it is written, "Arise, go with them and I will establish the matter and so on." Even though Hashem will bless the valley according to His will and Israel will receive many blessings at my hands. Balaam, even so, did not need to rush into this journey. And when he went, even though God had finished according to His will, even so, the multitude was punished forever, as our rabbis said, remembering them in blessing, there:

segments.he: וע"כ אע"פ שחותכין את הערלה עדיין כל זמן שלא פרע וגילה את העטרה כאלו לא מל. זה בחי' מה שנאמר שם במאמר הנ"ל שאע"פ שזוכין להכניע ולשבר ולבטל חכמת הטבע אעפ"כ כל זמן שאין התגלות הרצון חזק עדיין הם יכולים להתגבר חס ושלום וכו'. וזה בחי' הדר תליא ליה וכו' ע"ש היטב. וזה בחי' פריעה שאע"פ שחותכין הערלה שהוא זוהמת הנחש החופה על הברית בחי' חכמת הטבע החופה על הדעת אעפ"כ כל זמן שאין מגלין העטרה דקדושה שהוא בחי' תיקון הברית בחי' התגלות הרצון כנ"ל עדיין יש להם אחיזה חס ושלום ויכולין להתגבר עדיין אע"פ שכבר הכניע אותם וחתכו הערלה לגמרי כנ"ל ועל כן צריכין להתגבר אח"כ לפרוע ולגלות העטרה דהיינו לגלות הרצון שיתגלה הרצון בתוקף וחוזק גדול שידעו הכל שהעולם מתנהג רק ברצונו ית' לבד ואזהוא עיקר הכנעתם. וזה בחי' התגלות העטרה ע"י הפריעה כנ"ל:
segments.en: And Samson was mistaken, because he saw that Israel was greatly humiliated under the Philistines, and he saw that it was difficult to choose the best among them to save Israel, and he thought that by the grace of the mother he would choose the best among them, because he knew that there is a good that cannot be chosen from the skins, because if by the grace of the mother, as mentioned in the above Torah. And so he went to take a wife from there. And indeed he saw, but he did not know what he saw, for indeed it was from Hashem that he went to take a wife from there. And yet, in His choice, there was no need for a night later than this, for this is the thing that cannot be achieved as usual. And this is a test in the way that a person wants to spend a night leading him, as it is written, "Arise, go with them and I will establish the matter and so on." Even though Hashem will bless the valley according to His will and Israel will receive many blessings at my hands. Balaam, even so, did not need to rush into this journey. And when he went, even though God had finished according to His will, even so, the multitude was punished forever, as our rabbis said, remembering them in blessing, there:...

segments.he: וזה שהוזהר אהרן מאחרי מות בניו לבל יבא בכל עת אל הקודש שלא יכנוס לפנים כי אם על ידי עבודות יום כפור שאז הוא תיקון הברית וכל העבודות של הקרבנות כולם בשביל זה, דהיינו להכניע רוח הבהמיות שהוא פגם הברית (כמו שכתוב בזוהר הקדוש אל תהיו כסוס כפרד אין הבין וכו' עין שם) וגם שיהיה נשוי כמו שכתוב שם וכפר בעדו ובעד ביתו אז הוא ראוי ליכנוס אל הקודש פנימה לזכות לדעת גדול להמשיך משם לבנונית מחילה וסליחה כנ"ל. וזה שכתוב בזאת יבא אהרן כנ"ל היינו בחינת תיקון הברית שהוא בחינת בריתי אשר תשמורו וכמובא ועל כן אנו קורין ביום כפור כל פרשת עריות כי אז הוא בחינת תיקון הברית:
segments.en: And the one who warned Aaron after the death of his sons not to come into the Holy Place at any time, not to gather before, except through the works of the Yom Kippur, which is then the correction of the covenant and all the works of the sacrifices are all for this, namely, to subdue the spirit of bestiality, which is the defect of the covenant (as it is written in the Holy Zohar, "Do not be like a horse or a mule, for it does not understand, etc., see there) and also that he is married, as it is written there, and atones for himself and his family, then he is worthy of gathering into the Holy Place within to merit great knowledge, continuing from there with the Lebanese forgiveness and pardon as above. And the one who is written in this, Aaron will come in as above, meaning the aspect of the correction of the covenant, which is the aspect of My covenant that you shall keep, and as mentioned, and therefore we read on the Yom Kippur all the parashat of fornication, because then it is the aspect of the correction of the covenant:
